theme_description: Users are blocked from logging in due to broken SMS verification, browser-dependent auth flows, and frequent session expirations that lock them out at checkout.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus login is severely broken: SMS codes never arrive, the auth callback fails unless Chrome is the default browser, and users are repeatedly logged out — often discovering this at the till when discounts no longer apply.
rewe_summary: A single REWE user reports being unable to find a login path or sync their online shopping list, but volume is too low to draw conclusions.
ab_test_idea: Test whether replacing the external-browser OAuth handoff with an in-app webview plus email-based code fallback reduces login-failure support tickets by 50% within four weeks.
strategic_note: Login is a critical competitive vulnerability for Lidl Plus — 36 high-severity complaints versus 1 at REWE means churn at the moment of purchase, directly undermining the loyalty program's value.

theme_description: Users struggle with coupon activation, redemption reliability, and freshness of promotional offers shown in the app.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus users complain that manually activated coupons frequently fail to apply at checkout and that the per-item activation flow itself is tedious and unrewarding.
rewe_summary: REWE users overwhelmingly complain that the weekly offers shown in-app are stale, out of sync with actual store stock, and lack a scan-at-checkout coupon mechanism.
ab_test_idea: Test whether auto-activating all eligible coupons by default (vs. opt-in tap) increases coupon redemption rate per active user by 30% over a two-week pilot.
strategic_note: Both apps are weak here but in different ways — REWE has a content-freshness/backend sync problem while Lidl has a UX-friction and reliability problem; whoever fixes their side first gains a clear loyalty edge.

theme_description: This theme covers how the app supports the physical shopping journey: digital receipts, in-store connectivity, and scanner usability.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus users report that digital receipts are frequently unavailable when needed and that excessive gamification distracts from core in-store functions like pfand, coupons, and payment.
rewe_summary: A single REWE user notes that poor in-store mobile coverage makes the scanner and offer features unusable until they reach the exit.
ab_test_idea: Test whether caching the last 90 days of receipts locally on-device reduces 'receipt unavailable' complaints by 70% over six weeks.
strategic_note: Lidl's heavier in-store app reliance (scan-to-save, digital receipts) creates more surface area for failure than REWE's lighter footprint — a reliability win here protects Lidl's differentiator.

theme_description: This covers how points, rabattsammler thresholds, pfandbons, and reward redemption work within the loyalty program.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus users report QR codes failing to display, large purchases not credited to the Rabattsammler, and the new points system perceived as stingy enough to drive defection to Aldi.
rewe_summary: The two REWE comments are wishlist items — a staff-card section and clearer Payback integration — rather than complaints about broken mechanics.
ab_test_idea: Test whether lowering the Rabattsammler reward threshold by 25% and surfacing progress on the home screen increases weekly active loyalty-program users by 15%.
strategic_note: Lidl risks eroding the perceived value of its loyalty proposition just as REWE users are merely asking for nice-to-haves — a stingy reward economy is a self-inflicted competitive wound.

theme_description: Users are blocked from creating accounts due to failing SMS/email verification, capacity errors, and browser incompatibilities.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus registration is broken at scale — users face missing SMS codes, 'capacity exceeded' errors, Firefox incompatibility, and dozens of failed activation attempts.
rewe_summary: Only a single REWE review touches onboarding, expressing fear of accidental purchases rather than registration friction.
ab_test_idea: Test whether replacing the SMS verification with an email-based magic link reduces registration drop-off by 30%.
strategic_note: Lidl Plus has a critical onboarding funnel failure that REWE avoids simply because it requires no account — a competitive liability blocking Lidl's entire personalisation strategy.

theme_description: Users expect to browse the full assortment, order, and arrange delivery or pickup directly from the app.
lidl_summary: A single Lidl Plus complaint notes missing accessory products, suggesting only marginal assortment gaps.
rewe_summary: REWE users are frustrated that the app shows only weekly offers with no ordering, delivery, or account management — they expected a full e-commerce experience.
ab_test_idea: Test whether adding an in-app 'order for pickup/delivery' entry point from the shopping list increases weekly active users by 20% among urban users.
strategic_note: REWE's app is perceived as a brochure while a delivery service already exists separately — closing this integration gap is a major retention opportunity Lidl has not yet contested.

theme_description: Users want customization options like dark mode, landscape orientation, and decoupled language/region settings.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus users repeatedly demand dark mode, independent language-from-country settings, meaningful changelogs, and German-language support.
rewe_summary: REWE users specifically want tablet landscape support and PDF offer downloads, with some praising recent visual improvements.
ab_test_idea: Test whether shipping dark mode in Lidl Plus and landscape/tablet layout in REWE increases 30-day retention by 5% among power users.
strategic_note: Both apps have distinct customization debt — Lidl's gap is cross-border travelers, REWE's gap is tablet users — neither competitor has solved both, leaving open differentiation.

theme_description: Users cannot reliably complete payment or checkout flows, blocking transactions and Lidl Pay usage.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus suffers concrete checkout bugs — broken invoice payment, mismatched billing/shipping addresses with no warnings, and Lidl Pay incompatible with Android 17.
rewe_summary: REWE users complain that no payment or checkout exists at all, with ordering loops failing and the app perceived as functionally empty.
ab_test_idea: Test whether fixing Lidl Pay on Android 17 and adding an address-mismatch warning at checkout reduces payment-step abandonment by 25%.

theme_description: Users on both apps face crashes, broken post-update functionality, device compatibility issues, and connectivity errors that block core usage.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus users report widespread post-update breakages (Profile screen blank, partner benefits failing, prospect view crashes) and dropped support for older/beta Android devices, driving switches to competitors.
rewe_summary: REWE users hit false 'no internet' errors despite working connectivity, stale offer data after reinstall, slow load times on the offers list, and missing support for older Samsung devices.
ab_test_idea: Test whether a hotfix release targeting the post-update Profile/partner-benefits regression reduces crash-free-session complaints in 1-star reviews by 40% within 4 weeks.

theme_description: Users distrust the data collection practices of both apps, citing excessive registration requirements and unexplained permission requests.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus users refuse to register because phone number, birthday and address are mandatory, and some attribute unsolicited spam calls directly to Lidl sharing their data.
rewe_summary: REWE users question why the app requests camera, microphone and photo permissions, viewing this as inconsistent with REWE's privacy-conscious brand image.
ab_test_idea: Test whether adding just-in-time permission rationale dialogs and a 'minimal data' registration option increases registration completion rate by 15% versus the current mandatory-fields flow.

theme_description: Users on both apps struggle to find products, categories and core features due to broken search, missing scanners, and buried navigation.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus search returns wildly irrelevant results (Lachs → Gartenmöbel), the receipt search was removed, and key functions like EV charging and QR scanning are hidden in submenus.
rewe_summary: REWE users complain there is no general product search or full assortment (only offers), the barcode scanner frequently returns 'unknown article', and basic price lookup is impossible.
ab_test_idea: Test whether replacing the current search with a unified product+receipt+category search bar pinned to the home screen increases search-to-result-click rate by 25% and reduces 'cannot find' complaints.

theme_description: Users want a robust shopping list with barcode scanning, voice input, cross-device sync, and integration with weekly offers.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus has only a rudimentary list with no prospect-to-list integration, no sorting, and occasional crashes after Scan&Go integration — users explicitly request what REWE used to offer.
rewe_summary: REWE users are furious that a recent update stripped previously beloved list features (voice input, barcode scanner, multi-market, PC-mobile sync), turning a differentiator into a regression.
ab_test_idea: Test whether restoring REWE's voice input and barcode scanner, plus shipping a prospect-to-list 'add with one tap' feature in Lidl Plus, increases weekly active list users by 30% versus control.
strategic_note: REWE's shopping list was a genuine competitive moat over Lidl Plus; by removing voice and scanner features they have voluntarily surrendered that advantage just as Lidl users are explicitly asking for the same capability — a rare window for whichever team ships first to own the category.

theme_description: Covers how users locate nearby stores, switch between them, and see store-specific offers on a map.
lidl_summary: Lidl Plus users complain that the app locks them to a single Filiale, making it impractical for shoppers who move between stores.
rewe_summary: REWE users are frustrated that a recent update removed the multi-store map view, showing only a single selected market and surfacing offers tied to the wrong store.
ab_test_idea: Test whether restoring a multi-store map view with one-tap store switching increases weekly active sessions by 15% among users who open the store finder.
strategic_note: REWE shipped a regression that degraded a previously loved feature, while Lidl never built robust multi-store support at all — fixing this is a quick competitive win for whichever app moves first.
